site_name: Compass Datacenters PHX II, SW corner of Peoria Ave & El Mirage Rd, El Mirage, AZ 85335
verification: Near miss for verified_not_yet_operating, held back under the default-when-unsure rule. The operator's own release of 2026-09-23 (https://www.compassdatacenters.com/news/el-mirage-ymcas-outdoor-court/) says Compass "is developing a campus in El Mirage" and refers to "upon breaking ground"; the live markets page says Compass "is developing multiple sites including a 212 MW campus in Goodyear and a 108 MW campus in El Mirage." Quotes were read through WebFetch's summarizer. No page found that states an operating date. Compass news archive pages 1-7 (Aug 2025 to Nov 2026) have no other El Mirage item in titles/snippets.

lead.notes: Not yet a data center - all sources describe it as planned or under construction. Compass acquired 120 acres in 2022; Baxtel lists PHX II-2 as Under Construction with planned year 2027. Three buildings of 208KSF each were proposed. No evidence of commissioning found.

site_name: CyrusOne Chandler campus (PHX1-PHX8), 2335 S Ellis St, Chandler, AZ
year_evidence_quote: As of December 31, 2012, our property portfolio included 24 operating data centers in ten distinct markets (Austin, Chicago, Cincinnati, Dallas, Houston, London, Phoenix, San Antonio, Singapore and South Bend)
year_site_match: The FY2012 10-K operating-property table has a single Phoenix row, named "South Ellis Street (Phoenix)" (36,222 colocation sq ft, 57,138 total NRSF, 10 MW utility power). The FY2013 and FY2015 10-Ks name the same facility "South Ellis Street, Chandler, AZ (Phoenix)" / "South Ellis Street Chandler, AZ (Phoenix 1)". Permit address is 2335 S Ellis St, Chandler. It is CyrusOne's only Phoenix-area property in these filings.
verification: Page supports 2012, not the researcher's 2013. Cited Business Wire URL returned HTTP 403 (not worked around). CyrusOne's FY2012 10-K (opened on SEC EDGAR) lists South Ellis Street (Phoenix) in the operating-property table as of 2012-12-31 and says that in 2012 "we completed development of approximately 310,000 NRSF, primarily in Phoenix, Austin, Dallas, Houston and San Antonio"; the same filing reports the land purchase in 2011 and 2012 construction spending of $52.6 million at South Ellis Street. This matches the researcher's own note that the first phase was commissioned seven months after a May 2012 start. Caveat that matters for a load-based study: the row shows 0% leased and no rent at 2012-12-31; the FY2013 10-K shows 34% leased at 2013-12-31. So the building was completed and counted as operating in 2012, but first billed customers arrived in 2013. Under the task definition (commissioned/completed) the year is 2012; if the study wants first customer load, 2013 is defensible, and that is an orchestrator call. The Data Center Knowledge article (2014-10-17) confirms the second building was operational by October 2014 but gives no date for the first. Quotes were relayed by the fetch tool's text extraction of the filing; I did not view the raw HTML.

lead.year_evidence_quote: the first phase was commissioned in a record-setting seven months from the start of construction in May 2012
lead.notes: Construction started May 2012, commissioned 7 months later (late 2012/early 2013). Business Wire press release cites April 2013 open house. Data Center Frontier says delivered with January 2013 IPO. Second building came online October 2014. Campus address confirmed at 2335 S Ellis St in Chandler.

site_name: Stream Data Centers Phoenix I (PHXA), 2950 S Litchfield Rd, Goodyear, AZ 85338
year_evidence_quote: is proud to announce the commissioning of the new Phoenix I facility, a 418,000 square foot hyperscale data center in Goodyear, Arizona
year_site_match: Stream's Phoenix location page (streamdatacenters.com/locations/phoenix/) gives the campus address as 2950 S. Litchfield Road, Goodyear, Arizona 85338 and labels it Phoenix I / PHXA; both releases describe Phoenix I as the first of five buildings on Stream's 157-acre Goodyear campus, the same 418,000 sq ft building named in the Feb 2019 acquisition release.
verification: The researcher's cited URL (Feb 15, 2019 release) does not hold: it is forward-looking only, as the first checker found. The researcher's quoted wording actually comes from a different Stream release, dated January 14, 2021, which I opened. Bracket: Stream release of July 8, 2020 calls Phoenix I 'near-complete' with 'the first of five buildings on the new Goodyear Campus going live in August 2020' (not yet open); Stream release of January 14, 2021 announces the commissioning and says the City's partnership 'allowed us to complete the first phase of the project on schedule during an otherwise challenging year.' YEAR CAVEAT, stated plainly: the bracket runs July 8, 2020 to January 14, 2021 and so straddles two calendar years. I report 2020 because the January 2021 release describes completion on schedule during the 'challenging year' (my reading: 2020), and the schedule was August 2020; that reading is inference, not a stated date. Under a strict page-date rule the year would be 2021 (high-confidence form). The release gives no commissioning month; the researcher's 'October 2020' was not found on any page I opened. The DCD article in the record returned HTTP 403. Quotes were relayed by the fetch tool's summarizer.

lead.notes: Phoenix I commissioned October 2020 per Stream press release. First of five planned phases on 157-acre Goodyear campus. DataCenterDynamics reports 40 MW IT capacity. Phoenix II reportedly topped out and expected operational by 2025. Address confirmed at 2950 S Litchfield Rd. High confidence on 2020 date from operator announcement.
